reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. The spec deviation is real — route.ts contains zero signOut() calls anywhere, so the property 'session invalidated on oauth_failure' is never satisfied. However, Phase 03's proof trace is factually inaccurate: it claims signOut() is called at lines 101, 111, 116, 142 (the supposed structural comparator), but the file has no signOut() calls and is only 129 lines. The attack path (CSRF-redirect victim to callback with expired code → retain prior session) yields no attacker privilege gain; the victim merely retains their own legitimate session while being sent to /login. Concrete exploitability is uncertain, making CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL the appropriate verdict over CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY.
